title: Trump’s Latest Tariffs Hit With New Lawsuit by 25 States
title_cn: 特朗普的最新关税遭到 25 个州的新诉讼
summary: A group of 25 states filed a lawsuit challenging President Donald Trump’s new global tariffs that went into effect last month, adding to similar complaints by small businesses who claim the levies are illegal.

title: Michigan Democrats Brace for Tectonic Shift in Key Senate Race
title_cn: 密歇根州民主党人准备迎接参议院关键竞选的结构性转变
summary: The fight between the progressive and centrist wings of the Democratic party reaches its most consequential front of the 2026 midterm primary cycle with Michigan voters on Tuesday set to catapult either Abdul El-Sayed or Haley Stevens to a general election that could decide the balance of power in the US Senate.

title: Bessent Suggests US-Iran Hormuz Deal Possible in Coming Days
title_cn: 贝森特建议美国与伊朗霍尔木兹协议在未来几天内可能达成
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a deal between the US and Iran over control of the Strait of Hormuz could come as soon as Tuesday, sending oil prices plunging.
